title: An animated icon told as a little story moves through every beat: 'the lid opens, trash is thrown in, bounces off the lid and it closes'
goal: The user asked 'make an animated trash icon where the lid opens and some trash is thrown in, bouncing off the lid and causing it to close.' and got a still drawing of a trash can (Ask's row: drew a trash can), no motion. The shorter 'make an animated trash can icon where it opens, some trash is thrown in' animates in the walk. A request that tells the motion as several beats must be animated through all of them, never fall back to a still.
notes: User, 2026-11-07 (intake): 'i still can't seem to ask it to make an animated icon' ... 'for example "make an animated trash icon where the lid opens and some trash is thrown in, bouncing off the lid and causing it to close." This translates into draw a trashcan'. Their app (Photonz Dev, built 22:10 with c41e1fcd3 New window fix and e1ac11193 Ask animates) was current. The intake window's walk with the user's sentence (a copy of ask-animates-from-the-new-window-walk) got as far as 'made a 512 by 512 picture, as an icon' and then the probe quit with no crash report while the user's app held a 26 GB llama-server. Prior: ask-animates-what-it-makes-an-animated-svg-icon notes the trash animates for the shorter wording; asking-the-new-window-for-an-animated-icon-makes notes the moving route needs 'icon' or 'svg' and a blank icon.
acceptance: Reproduce with the user's exact words, in the New window AND with Command K on an empty picture, at Next defaults, on the user's Photonz Dev setup (the shipping model). Record Ask's plan: which route it took, which tools it planned, and why no keys were set. NOTE for reproducing on this Mac: the user's Photonz Dev holds the Ask model (26 GB); a probe walk loading a second copy was quit mid-walk with no crash report on 2026-11-07 (likely memory). Reuse the running model, or run when the user's app has let it go, rather than calling it a crash.

Find why a story with several beats (open, throw, bounce, close) drew a still: the moving-icon route not taken, the plan running out of rounds or context before the keys, a refused key call dropped, or a fallback to a drawing. Say which, with the plan as evidence.

Fix: a request for an animated icon NEVER ends as a still. If the full story cannot be planned, Ask animates as many beats as it can, in order, and its row says which it left out ('Animated the lid opening and closing; left out the bounce'). New eval cases with multi-beat stories (at least 6: this one, 'a letter goes into an envelope, the flap closes and it flies off', 'a bell swings, rings twice and settles', 'a heart beats twice then breaks', 'a rocket shakes, lifts off and leaves smoke', 'a checkbox is ticked and the tick bounces'), each judged on 'every beat asked for happens, in order' from contact sheets; at least 5 of 6 at 7 or more.

The objects a story needs are drawn as their own named layers so they can move (the trash, the lid on its hinge, the can), and the beats are keyed in time order with motion principles (anticipation, overshoot, settle), from the model's own planning, no coded animations per subject.
Walk with the user's exact sentence: the picture plays every beat, Copy SVG gives an animated SVG that loops.
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: Reproduced (cause found from the model logs, not guessed): the user's attempt at 22:47 on 7 Nov in Photonz Dev (pid 88232) took the STILL icon route: their llama-server log shows the break question (167 prompt tokens, 1 token back = no), then the still icon design (849 + about 320), then a 14,149 token still plan (all tools), never the motion design (1747) or the 3-tool moving plan (about 5,000). Tokenised with the model's own tokenizer, the user's quoted sentence gives 163 and 845 tokens for the same two calls: their typed words were 4 tokens longer and did not hold one of the exact words the motion check needs (animated, animate, animation, looping, gif). With the quoted sentence itself, the route is right: the New window walk made a 512 icon and keyed it (lid opens and closes, trash fades in), today 09:18 run, and the user's own app at 09:10 today ran the 3-tool moving route too. So the still came from routing on exact keywords, not the plan running out of rounds (30) or context (16k of 64k), and not a refused key call (the motion check already sends back a plan with no keys, twice).

Built (test first, AskMotionStoryTests): (1) a slip of the keyboard in the word for motion (anmiated, animted, animatd) still asks for motion, animal/anime/animator do not; (2) an icon request whose words name no motion asks the model one short question first (moves or still); measured on qwen3.8-27b: asking only whether it moves turned 5 one-action stills (balloon popping, door opening, bell ringing, bubble bursting, refresh) into moving icons, so the wording says one action is a still and only an ask for motion or two or more things one after another moves: 26 of 26 right (17 stills, 9 stories); (3) a designed moving icon is sent back once to go through its beats in order and finish with Left out: <beats> or nothing, which lands on the row as 'Left out the bounce; it could not be planned.', and a moving icon that never got keys says 'Left out the motion'; (4) motion rules for a story: beats in the order told, each long enough to read, what a beat causes starts where the parts touch, nothing appears out of nowhere, the whole object moves as one group, a shake is big enough to see, a hanging thing swings with rotation. Baseline of six new story cases (run 20261108-172723-ask): 63.1, 29.6, 60, 23.8, 39.3, 52.1; reads as asked 6, 3, 6, 3, 4, 5, none at 7.

Shipped in b438830e8 (pushed): typo-tolerant motion words, the model's moves-or-still question (26 of 26), beats gone through once with Left out: on the row, and four send-backs true of any subject (journey too quick, motion too small, a turn that swings into what stays still, a position written as where a part sits). Scripts/test.sh exit 0 (one stopwatch test, the animated chart at 1080p, failed once while the user's model was loaded and passed alone and in the next full run). Walks at Next defaults: ask-animates-a-story-walk (the user's sentence; the first try on the new code failed expectPictureMoves because the trash was keyed at x 12 y 14, off the icon, which the new position check fixed) and ask-animates-a-story-without-the-word-walk (model said moves: 3 moving parts) both pass, play on Space, Copy SVG has repeatCount=indefinite. Single motions unhurt: bell 80.8, checkmark 91, heart 89.8; trash lid 27.7 then 74.8 with the swing check. Pictures looked at: the reel frames show the lid lift, the trash appear beside it, hit the lid end with a bounce mark, drop in, the lid shut, rest. Audit queue/audits/2026-11-08-animated-icon-told-as-a-story.json.

NOT DONE, the bar: six story cases, need 5 of 6 at reads-as-asked 7 or more; reached 0 of 6 (runs 20261108-172723 baseline 6,3,6,3,4,5; 20261108-191056 after rules and the first checks 6,3,3,3,3,4; the swing and position checks landed after, measured only on the trash cases). What is left is the model's own story design: things fade in where they land instead of travelling in (trash, checkbox), a rocket smoke dot and a leave too fast to see, the envelope's beats out of order. Next try: a look-and-revise pass (render frames of the planned motion, show them to the model, let it fix beats), a general technique. The eval also needs the person away (its walks take the front) and the user's own model let go (two 28 GB copies do not fit): today about an hour went to waiting. Left rough, no task earned: the moves question costs about a second on every still icon whose words do not say animated.
Routing fixed and shipped (b438830e8): a story always animates; story eval bar not met (0 of 6 at 7), left open for a look-and-revise pass

Built and shipped e78463fd9: a look at the motion before it lands (AskMotionLook). Twelve frames of the lap on white go to the planning model with the request; it names the frames that show each beat or says not seen, and what looks wrong; anything but All good goes back once (drawing kept, keys replaced), then lands. Prototype first on a model copy I started (bounded, killed): shown last run's frames it named the judge's own faults in 20 to 30 s. Guard: only while the request is under 150 s, and one more rule send-back after it, not two. Tests AskMotionLookTests (8), Scripts/test.sh exit 0 on the second full run (the first had BusyVideoSizeTests fail once under load; it passed alone 8 of 8 and in the next full run).

Measured. Six story cases, reads as asked: baseline 6,3,3,3,3,4 (run 20261108-191056, total 34.8); with the look 5,6,6,3,5,4 (20261108-210016, total 49.1); second wording (contact, direction, going behind, leaving the frame is fine) 5,6,4,5,4 and the heart out of its 300 s (20261108-213042, 40.8). Single motions with the look 69.9 vs 72.3 (20261108-220616 vs 193403): bell 61.5 vs 80.8 (judge: shears, no crown; the look moved only the sound waves), checkmark 88, heart 91.6, trash lid 38.6. Walks ask-animates-a-story-walk and ask-animates-a-story-without-the-word-walk pass at Next defaults, but their plans took 264 s and 267 s, so the guard skipped the look: the user's own sentence does not get it yet.

NOT DONE, the bar: 5 of 6 story cases at reads as asked 7 or more; reached 0 of 6 (best 6). Pictures looked at: run 210016 heart frames (two beats, crack, halves part; crack floats loose, long broken hold) and bell frames (rigid swing, cap left behind). What is left: (1) the story plan is slow, mostly rule send-backs and the beats review going round (the trash: 17 turns, 265 s), so the look rarely fits for the trash; making the plan quicker is the next lever; (2) the look is lenient on contact (it called the trash's bounce seen in run 1 though it never touched the lid); the second wording fixes that offline but costs time; (3) drawing craft the judge marks down (bell reads as a lampshade, heart crack floats). Left rough, no new task (all inside this one): the look nearly always sends back, so it costs a re-plan even on good motion.
Look before landing shipped (e78463fd9): story total 34.8 to 49.1, reads as asked best 6; bar (5 of 6 at 7) not met. Next lever: a quicker story plan so the look fits the user's trash sentence.
